verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs say it supports more than 20 public or private package registry types, explicitly including npm, PyPI, Maven, Container, Helm, NuGet, Cargo and others. A community user confirms the 1.17 package registry let them replace Verdaccio, a self-hosted npm registry, in practice. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of the publish/consume workflow per format (client configuration, authentication), and hands-on corroboration beyond npm.
